With the stock at US$153.05 and sentiment already supported by recent gains, investors are weighing whether the current price still leaves meaningful upside according to the broader metrics. Over the last 5 years, EOG Resources has returned 178.3%, which puts the recent share price in the context of a strong longer term run...
